Container.Name: Cove
Container.Overview: Cove is a local media organizer for videos, images, galleries, audio, and text. This template is the Cove app container (ghcr.io/yourcove/cove-app). It requires PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector running separately. Point the connection string at that database before starting Cove.[br][br]On a custom Docker network, set Host to the PostgreSQL container name. On the default bridge network, set Host to your Unraid server IP and publish PostgreSQL port 5432.[br][br]After the container starts, open the WebUI and complete first-run setup. Add /media as a library path inside Cove. Do not expose the WebUI to the internet until you have created the owner account.[br][br]Keep appdata on a cache pool. The app runs as uid 1000; if startup reports it cannot write to /config, run chown -R 1000:1000 /mnt/user/appdata/cove from the Unraid terminal.[br][br]GPU transcoding is optional. Pick one path:[br]Intel/AMD: set VAAPI Device to /dev/dri, then choose VAAPI or QSV in Cove Settings - Transcoding.[br]NVIDIA: install the Nvidia-Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (not --gpus all), set NVIDIA Visible Devices to all, then choose NVENC in Cove Settings - Transcoding.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Cove configuration, installed extensions, and logs

Config.Name: Generated Assets
Config.Description: Covers, thumbnails, previews, and other derived assets. Can grow large; move to a share if needed.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Automatic database backups created before migrations

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Host path to your media library. Add /media as a library path in Cove. Change to read-only to prevent source deletion and extension-provided rename operations. Add more Path mappings for additional shares.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Connection String
Config.Description: PostgreSQL 18 with pgvector. On a custom docker network, Host is the database container name. On bridge, set Host to your Unraid server IP.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Reserved for managed PostgreSQL data. Unused with the external database in this template.

Config.Name: Managed PostgreSQL
Config.Description: Must stay false. This image uses the external PostgreSQL connection string.

Config.Name: Hardware Acceleration
Config.Description: none, nvenc, vaapi, or qsv. You can also set this in Cove Settings - Transcoding.

Config.Name: VAAPI Device
Config.Description: Intel/AMD GPU for VAAPI or QSV. Set to /dev/dri when using those backends. Leave empty for NVIDIA or CPU-only.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Visible Devices (requires --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters)
Config.Description: Requires --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters. Set to all or a GPU UUID. Do not use --gpus all on Unraid.

Config.Name: NVIDIA Driver Capabilities (requires --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters)
Config.Description: Requires --runtime=nvidia in Extra Parameters. Typical value: all
